findings: Dead emoji block in getGreetingText — the function assigns emoji twice; the first assignment (ternary + single if) is always overwritten by the second if/else chain immediately below it. Remove the first block.

Name-clear prompt silently ignored — the btn-edit-name handler discards an empty submission, so a user cannot clear a previously saved name. Treat empty trimmed input as 'clear name' rather than 'cancel'.
